tips.title: Aligning Wings Using Tamiya Wing Alignment Jigs
tips.text: For kits like Trumpeter's 1/32nd Fw 190, use Tamiya Wing Alignment Jigs to ensure perfect wing alignment. Apply the jigs to the wing roots after dry-fitting. Apply Tamiya Extra Thin Cement to the jig's contact points, let it tack for 10 seconds, then apply strong pressure. Allow 30 minutes cure time before removing the jigs. Align and glue the wings, using clamps if necessary.

tips.title: Installing Eduard Photo-Etch Parts with Super Glue
tips.text: Before installing Eduard photo-etch parts, peel off the protective film and fit-check each piece. Apply a small amount of Revell Contacta Super Glue to the back of each part, then carefully place it on the model. Press gently with tweezers until the glue sets (about 10 seconds). Remove any excess glue with a cotton swab dampened with isopropyl alcohol.

tips.title: Assembling Trumpeter Multi-Part Gun Barrels
tips.text: Trumpeter's multi-part gun barrels can be challenging. Dry-fit parts, then apply Tamiya Extra Thin Cement to the contact points. Use tweezers to hold parts together while they tack-weld (about 10 seconds). For the breech, apply cement to the back of the recoil system, insert it into the breech ring, then use tweezers to hold it in place while it sets.

tips.title: Strengthening Thin Parts with Brass Rod
tips.text: Strengthen thin parts like Meng's 1/35th StuG III's mantlet using brass rod. Measure and cut a length of 1.2mm brass rod with cutters. Drill a 1.2mm hole into the mantlet's center using a pin vise. Insert the rod, secure it with CA glue, then trim and sand flush. Paint and weather as desired.

tips.title: Working with Clear Prop Models Resin Conversion Kits
tips.text: Working with resin kits like Clear Prop Models' 1/72nd Bf 109E-7 Cowling requires care. Clean parts with soap and water, then remove mold lines with a sharp hobby knife. Use CA glue to assemble parts, tack-welding for 10 seconds before applying pressure. For complex assemblies, use a vice with soft jaws and apply gentle pressure. Allow 24 hours cure time before handling.
